name: XOX Room
description: Play XOX against an attached AI slot through room-scoped ++cmd commands.

commandSpecs.name: XOXStartGame
commandSpecs.description: Start a new XOX game and send the room protocol to the selected AI slot.

commandSpecs.name: XOXUserMove
commandSpecs.description: Apply the user move from the room UI and request the AI response.

commandSpecs.name: XOXAIMove
commandSpecs.description: Apply the AI move returned with ++cmd:XOXAIMove({...}).

commandSpecs.name: XOXResetGame
commandSpecs.description: Reset the room game state to idle.

commandSpecs.name: XOXSyncState
commandSpecs.description: Push the current XOX room state to the UI runtime.

commandSpecs.name: XOXShowResult
commandSpecs.description: Update the room result banner from host-side game logic.
